_comment: Single source of truth for CS Party tips (ISSUE). Edit here, then run tools/gen_tips.py to regenerate plugin/cs_party_tips.inc. when: turn = start of your turn, wait = while others play; on = space just landed on; dev = only for that input device. Keep text <= 100 chars: the HUD wraps at 30 (PC) / 36 (phone) characters.

tips.text: On your turn, pick Buy gear in the menu to arm up for the minigames.
Gear you buy comes into the minigames. Survive the round and you keep it. Die and it's gone.
Died in a minigame? Players can pick up your weapons, so grab theirs too.
Pistol Round uses only your pistol, armor and grenades. Full Buy uses everything you own.
A Defuse Kit defuses a C4 trap on a space and pays you $500.
Gear costs board money. Blue spaces earn it, so don't spend your last dollar before a star.
Use items from your turn menu, before you jump at the crate.
Knife Out ($500): two dice crates on your next roll.
Bhop Script ($1200): three dice crates on your next roll.
Rigged Crate ($900): you pick the number your roll lands on.
Fake Call ($300): a rival's next roll is 3 lower.
Smoke ($400): C4 traps and the Camper can't hurt you this turn.
C4 ($800): plant a trap on your space. A rival who lands on it pays you $1500.
Rotate ($1000): swap places with a rival. Good when they're ahead.
Hostage Intel ($4000): jump straight to the hostages. Bring $5000 to rescue them.
You can carry 3 items. Use one before you pick up another.
Blue (CT) spaces pay you cash. Red (T) spaces cost you cash.
The last blue or red space you land on before a minigame sets your team color.
? spaces are random events: a free weapon, a bonus, a bad flash, or a swap.
Black Market: spend money on items. T and CT markets stock different things.
Armory: a free item off the rack. A full kit sells it for cash instead.
Camper: a sniper takes cash, a weapon, your items or even a star. Smoke blocks the shot.
Duel space: pick a rival for a 1v1 fight. The winner takes the cash.
VIP Escort: a slot reel decides who pays whom. Anything can happen.
The Negotiator: pay to take cash or a star from a rival as you pass.
Bomb site: you earn $300 and a C4 trap appears on a space further down the road.
A C4 trap hurts whoever lands on it. A Defuse Kit or Smoke saves you.
Open the map overlay from your turn menu to see every space's type.
Reach the hostages and pay $5000 to rescue them for a star.
Everyone stops at the hostages as they pass. No $5000? You walk on.
After a rescue, the hostages move to a new spot on the board.
Most stars when the turns run out wins. Money breaks ties.
Two bonus stars are drawn each match. The leaders are listed on the table.
Bonus stars pay out at the end to the leader, like Top Fragger or Max Money.
Hold TAB to see the stars and who's winning.
After every player moves, everyone plays a minigame. Winners earn cash.
In team minigames, blue is CT and red is T. Same color, same team.
Hide and Seek: T hides. CT seeks with a knife after 20 seconds in the dark.
Surf, Bhop, Climb and Maze are races. Fall and you go back to the last checkpoint.
Two Towers: AWPs and Deagles. Last side standing wins.
Each character has its own dice. Check the faces on the character screen.
SEAL Team 6 only rolls 3s and 4s. Steady, never huge.
Guerilla Warfare rolls only 1s and 6s. All or nothing.
Elite Crew and GSG-9 can roll a 0 and stand still, or a 7 and fly.
Jump into the floating crate to stop it. It lands on the face showing.
Space picks menu items and jumps at the crate. E goes back. Number keys work too.
On a phone, push the stick up or down to move the menu cursor. Tap Jump to pick.
On a controller, the stick or D-pad moves the menu cursor. The jump button picks.
Press Esc to open settings: sound, mouse, text size and more.
Tap the Menu button to open settings.
Press Start on a controller to open settings.
Say /help in chat to read the rules again.
Say /board in chat to pick the board map before a match.
Say /party in chat to start the match.
Closed your turn menu by mistake? Say /menu to bring it back.
